newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil spreads stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, gas oil spreads stable.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday, traders said.
Gas oil spreads were stable while outright levels shed 25 cents. An EN590 diesel cargo traded cif NWE at July IPE +$6.50.
Gasoline was broadly steady. Eurograde barges were hovering around $187 fob ARA with cargoes about $4 lower.

High sulphur fuel barges were steady but again on the upside of the past two days' close, trading mostly at $85 fob ARA, but also at $84.50. Low sulphur barges were unchanged, quietly talked at $95/$97.

High sulphur cargoes were offered firmer, on the back of crude and little supply. One percent offers were steady to a little firmer at $95/$96 and potential buyers were seen moving up their bids to some 50 cents to $1.50 below those levels.
